name: RFA One
tagline: Germany's small launcher: stacked at SaxaVord in 2026, first launch now in 2027
description: RFA One is the three-stage launcher of Rocket Factory Augsburg, about 30 m tall and 2 m wide. Its first stage has nine Helix engines of 100 kN each, running on RP-1 and liquid oxygen; the third stage is the Redshift OTV. Its payload figures differ: 500 kg to a sun-synchronous orbit in an ESA caption, 1,300 kg in Wikipedia. On 2024-08-19 a static fire of the first stage with all nine engines ended in fire and an explosion: the stage was lost and the launch mount badly damaged. RFA received a UK launch licence in January 2025. The rocket was delivered to SaxaVord in February and March 2026 and fully stacked in July; on 2026-07-28 an issue found in testing led to de-stacking. In November 2026 the first launch slipped to 2027, with no window set. It has never flown.
best_known_for: Germany's three-stage small launcher, stacked at SaxaVord in 2026 and not yet flown
